_comment: JOIN BACKBONE. Area names are spelled differently across the shapefile (nome_subar), the camera CSV (nome_area_fm), and the RELINT filenames. This registry reconciles them by a stable area_id. polygon_source = 'shapefile' when a polygon exists, else 'camera_hull' (derive an approximate boundary from the area's camera point cloud). Identification fields known from the reference report are filled; the rest are derived from data (aisp/bairro via crime sjoin, orcrim via dominio_territorial overlap) or left for the analyst (human-in-the-loop).
